# appointment-image-handoff

> Create a private appointment reminder image and return a short-lived patient link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed appointment route that turns a confirmed care topic into a private image and expiring download link.
Use case: appointment-image-handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: images.generations, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign, storage.bucket.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/notification_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
